title: HatePrototypes: Interpretable and Transferable Representations for Implicit and Explicit Hate Speech Detection

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model classification performance and cross-domain transferability on the Social Bias Inference Corpus (SBIC), which captures implicit statements conveying stereotypes or biased assumptions about various demographic groups.

Analyzing fine-grained implicit hate classification performance on the Implicit Hate Corpus (IHC), specifically evaluating categories like 'white grievance', and conducting qualitative analysis of misclassifications involving African American English expressions and specific racial targets.

Measuring the model's ability to detect explicit and implicit hate speech directed at protected groups (based on race, religion, gender, etc.) across multiple benchmark datasets (OLID, HateXplain, IHC, SBIC) using prototype-based classification and early-exiting.
